description: Get the public profile of one GigNGo local by their profile slug. Returns name, bio, skills, prices the local set, reviews, whether they filmed their work, neighbor vouches (with what named neighbors said), the lines the local picked for "you'll probably like working with me if", self-reported badges, service area, availability, a profile URL, `takesAssistantRequests: true` when the local said yes to requests sent through AI assistants, and `limits` (GigNGo runs no background checks). Slugs come from search_local_workers results (the "slug" field) or from gigngo.org/worker-profile/{slug} URLs.
name: get_worker_profile
title: Read a local's profile
